name: Dala
tagline: Vegetables, fruit and dairy from farms near Tashkent, at your door within a day

listing.description: A website for farm delivery, an organic shop or a greengrocer. A crate that fills with vegetables on the first screen, the week’s harvest as tag cards, boxes in three sizes and a delivery route with a moving van.

seo.title: Dala — farm produce delivery in Tashkent
seo.description: Seasonal vegetables, fruit, dairy and eggs straight from farms in Tashkent region. The weekly box starts at 290,000 UZS, next-day delivery, pay on receipt.
seo.answer: Dala delivers farm produce across Tashkent. The Small weekly box for one or two people costs 290,000 UZS, the Family box 490,000 UZS and the Large box 690,000 UZS. Orders placed before 18:00 arrive the next day between 9:00 and 21:00; delivery in Tashkent is free from 300,000 UZS, and you pay by cash or card on receipt.

sections.title: Food that was in the field yesterday
sections.eyebrow: Today we pick for tomorrow’s orders
sections.subtitle: We gather vegetables, fruit and dairy from 14 farms in Tashkent region and deliver within a day — no warehouses, no long supply chain, no middleman mark-up.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A short road from farm to table
sections.text: We started with one farm in Bostanlyk and friends who were tired of tasteless supermarket tomatoes. Today we work with 14 farms: vegetables from Parkent, fruit from Bostanlyk, dairy and eggs from Zangiata. Every morning we collect what was picked the day before, sort it and deliver it. Whatever doesn’t sell goes to canteens, so nothing sits around for weeks.

items.author: Bakhtiyor R.

items.quote: I order herbs and cucumbers for my café. Fresher than the bazaar, and no 6 a.m. trip.
items.author: Dilshod M.

items.a: Orders placed before 18:00 arrive the next day. You pick a three-hour window between 9:00 and 21:00.
Free in Tashkent from 300,000 UZS, otherwise 25,000 UZS. Delivery to the region is arranged individually.

items.q: Can I change what’s in the box?
items.a: Yes. Mark what you don’t want and we’ll swap it for something else from the week’s harvest of the same weight.
Cash or card to the courier on delivery, or a transfer via Payme or Click.
Send a photo on Telegram on the day of delivery and we’ll refund it or replace it with your next order.
